# Inline Meaning and Links

<a id="_ui_macros_and_literal_fallbacks"></a>
## UI macros and literal fallbacks

UI: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>P</kbd>, **[Save]**, File > Open > Recent, [Back].

Passthrough: <mark>raw</mark>, &lt;tag&gt; &amp; &amp;#169;, and © → … — .

STEM: `x < y` and `a_b`.

<a id="_roles"></a>
## Roles

Roles: <s class="line-through">removed</s>, <mark class="highlight">marked</mark>, <u class="underline">underlined</u>, <span class="big" style="font-size: larger">large</span>, <small class="small">small</small>, <span class="subtitle" style="font-size: smaller">subtitle</span>, <span class="pre-wrap" style="white-space: pre-wrap">two  spaces</span>, <span class="custom">custom</span>, and <s class="custom line-through">combined</s>.

<a id="_links_and_footnotes"></a>
## Links and footnotes

Visible links: [https://example.com/path](https://example.com/path); [label \[part\]](https://example.com/a_\(b\)); [Email](mailto:user@example.com); [&lt;user@example.com&gt;](mailto:user@example.com); [https://example.com/bracketed](https://example.com/bracketed).

Hidden schemes: [example.com/hidden](https://example.com/hidden); [example.com/linked](https://example.com/linked); [example.com/auto](https://example.com/auto).

Footnote body is retained.<sup>[[1]](#_footnote_named)</sup> The same note is referenced again.<sup>[[1]](#_footnote_named)</sup>

<a id="_delimiters"></a>
## Delimiters

Delimiter text: ``tick ` inside``, `nested formatting`, **bold *nested emphasis***, \*literal stars\*, \[literal brackets\], and [label \[part\]](https://example.com/a_\(b\)).

<strong>Footnotes</strong>

1. <a id="_footnote_named"></a>Body with **bold** and `code`.
